## Summary

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes
- [ ] New behavior has tests
- [ ] No API keys, cookies, credentials, or personal data committed
- [ ] Security boundaries and user approvals remain intact
- [ ] README/docs updated for user-visible changes

## Risk and rollback
